a: Observing time on the NOEMA interferometer and the IRAM 30-m telescope for the summer scheduling period (1 Jun - 30 Nov). PIs at institutes outside IRAM partner countries compete for a reserved share: 7.5% of NOEMA time and 15% of 30-m time.
dt: The winter 2026 deadline was 10 Sep 2026, 17:00 CEST. IRAM deadlines fall around mid-March and mid-September, and the summer-semester call is published by early February.
e: Twice-yearly call for IRAM's millimeter telescopes in France and Spain. PIs at institutes in non-partner countries, including the US, may submit regular proposals but may not lead Large Programs.
n: IRAM NOEMA and 30-meter Telescope Call for Proposals, Summer Semester 2027
unv: The summer 2027 call and its exact deadline are not yet posted. Student-PI rules are not stated.
